content.rendered:
Reporteros Level 1 and Level 2

The Sherwood School District is recommending that Reporteros be adopted by the Sherwood Board of Directors as instructional materials for World Languages.  Currently, the world language offered by the District is Spanish. Below, you will find links to the World Language Standards as well as options to access lessons and instructional materials, and a form to provide feedback. All feedback will be shared with the Board of Directors and the community prior to a vote on adoption of the materials, currently scheduled for June 8, 2022.

Print copies of these materials will also be available in the District Office, Sherwood Middle School, and Sherwood High School during regular business hours.

World Language Standards released by the Oregon Department of Education (ODE)

How to Access Reporteros 1 (Level 1)

  • Go to www.blinklearning.com.
  • Click Login in the right-hand corner
  • Enter the Email and Password below.
    • Email: PublicReview@sherwood.k12.or.us
    • Password: KlettWL4055

How to Access Reporteros 2 (Level 2)

For review purposes only, not to be copied, photographed or shared. These materials will be uploaded to blinklearning.com June 2022.

  • Reporteros 2 – Student Edition
  • Reporteros 2 – Workbook

Please provide your feedback on the above instructional materials using this form.

Thank you for reviewing these materials!
